quotes.text: App crashes every time I try to pay rent via UPI. Can't complete payment.
KYC verification stuck at PAN check for 3 days. Tried reinstalling.
Withdrawal requested 48 hours ago still not credited. Support not replying.

ideas: Fix UPI pending/double-debit: add idempotency + live status — Eng — Track refund SLA (target <24h)
Cut KYC drop-off: autofetch PAN/Aadhaar via registered phone number + inline validation + selfie light guide — Product — Track approval %
Make withdrawals transparent: show fee + ETA + confirm account before debit — Ops — Track pending tickets
